title: pfr operation
description: Isothermal plug-flow reactor. The volume is integrated by RK4; nSteps controls the spatial discretisation.

V_R.title: Reactor volume
V_R.description: Total reactor volume; RK4 integrates over the residence-time interval [0, V_R / Q_feed].

nSteps.title: Integration steps
nSteps.description: Axial steps along the tube; defaults to 100.

writeInterval.title: Profile write interval
writeInterval.description: Write every Nth step to the axial profile; 0 (default) writes none.

thermalMode.title: Thermal mode
thermalMode.description: isothermal (default), adiabatic, or heatExchange — the last removing U·(a/V)·(T − T_coolant) along the tube. Any other word is REFUSED.

areaPerVolume.title: Heat-transfer area per volume
areaPerVolume.description: Tube surface per unit reactor volume. Required by `thermalMode heatExchange`.

catalystLoading.title: Catalyst loading
catalystLoading.description: Mass of catalyst per unit reactor volume.

L_over_D.title: Bed slenderness L/D
L_over_D.description: Multi-reaction path only. Gives the bed a cross-section (D, L, A published as KPIs) as the straight cylinder of V_R at this ratio; the `pfr` sizer builds the shell on it and REFUSES a second L_over_D in its designRules -- one home. Required by `pressureDrop`.

catalyst.title: Catalyst particle
catalyst.description: The particle the bed is packed with, read by the Ergun `pressureDrop`. (Until 2026-10-12 a dysonSimon1968 bed's Eq 39 read it too; since DEV.md 4c C67 a rate law is written in the case and declares its own particle as a parameter of its formula.) No default.

particleDiameter.title: Particle diameter
particleDiameter.description: Taken by Ergun as the equivalent-sphere diameter (an irregular granule's sieve size overstates it: the drop is then a lower estimate). No default.

pressureDrop.title: Bed pressure drop (opt-in)
pressureDrop.description: Multi-reaction path only. Integrates Ergun's dP/dz = -[150 mu (1-eps)^2 u/(eps^3 dp^2) + 1.75 rho (1-eps) u^2/(eps^3 dp)] along the bed with the species, on the L_over_D cross-section; the rate law and T read the local P and the outlet leaves at P_in - dP. Needs a declared transport (viscosity) model. Absent, the bed is at constant pressure.

model.title: Correlation
model.description: Ergun, Chem. Eng. Prog. 48 (1952) 89. Any other word is REFUSED.

voidFraction.title: Bed void fraction
voidFraction.description: No default: the drop goes as (1-eps)/eps^3.

allowable.title: Allowable drop
allowable.description: Optional design budget; a drop above it is ANNOUNCED (never clamped) with the (L/D)^2 remedy.
